core_obligations: Reduce the statement to the comparison of the two fibre products over the two residue fields.
Apply the field-theoretic criterion for geometric reducedness to conclude the equality of loci.

proof_roadmap.step: Compare the base-changed fibre with the original fibre over the residue field.
Apply the criterion for geometric reducedness under field extension.
Conclude the equality of the two loci.

difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the locus of points of the base-changed family whose fibre is geometrically reduced with the inverse image of the corresponding locus for the original family, for an arbitrary base change. The proof reduces to the statement that the base-changed fibre is geometrically reduced over the residue field of the new point exactly when the original fibre is geometrically reduced over its residue field, which is a comparison of the two fibre products and follows from the behaviour of geometric reducedness under field extension. The reduction to the field-theoretic comparison is the content. Retained author proof at lines 7172-7178.
